thread:
Priest (Sales): handing off VentureX to CS. Mid-market fintech, 90-day pilot (4 seats). They need Okta SSO, EU data residency, private eval in eu-west, and Sumo Logic forwarding for audit logs. Renewal ~11 months. @Dana can you own this? Contract: https://redwood.at/venturex-pilot

Dana (CS): happy to take lead. Quick q: who is the technical contact and do they plan heavy load tests that may require Dedicated later?

Priest (Sales): tech lead is "Marco Diaz" (marco@venturex.finance). Pilot expected low concurrency but they plan a load test in week 3 which could spike. Sales flagged potential Dedicated if we see sustained high tail latency. They also want a short feedback survey after pilot end.

Ellen (Infra): for private eval in eu-west we'll need CIDRs, peering method, and client cert for mTLS. Sumo needs an HTTP endpoint and auth token; egress to collector.sumologic.com:443. If they want S3 exports for audit logs we can provide that too.

Kofi (Support Eng): Sumo usually ingests JSON over HTTPS. I'll draft Sumo mapping (audit->sumo) and a troubleshooting checklist (token errors, cert chain, firewall). Also will include runbook steps for token rotation. Any preferred kickoff windows (CET)?

Rae (Onboarding PM): I can schedule. Recommend 20-min tech kickoff + 45-min enablement. Morning CET preferred. Dana, want Tue or Thu next week?

Dana (CS): Tue morning works. Proposed action owners:
1) Collect CIDRs + cert + Sumo token (owner: Marco / VentureX)
2) Confirm Okta metadata (owner: Priest)
3) Provision private eval in eu-west (owner: Ellen)
4) Create pilot feedback doc + survey (owner: Dana)
5) Schedule kickoff + enablement (owner: Rae)

Priest (Sales): adding compliance note: theyre in payments space, asked about PCI scope later. Flag security.

Kofi (Support Eng): noted. I'll include sample JSON payloads and common errors in the runbook. Will post link once done.

Ellen (Infra): infra snippet for planning:
```
redwoodctl create private --region eu-west-1 --profile venturex-pilot --size m8g
```
I'll open INF ticket after CIDRs arrive.

crm-bot: CRM note created and assigned: account_owner=Priest, renewal_owner=Priest, onboarding_owner=Dana

Dana (CS): ok final checklist: Priest to confirm Okta metadata and keep renewal ownership; Marco to send CIDRs/cert/Sumo token by EOD tomorrow; Ellen to create INF ticket INF-9710 once assets arrive; Rae to propose two kickoff times Tue AM CET; Kofi to draft runbook and post link. I'll also create a short pilot goals doc (NPS + 4 workflow checks) and share with the team.

Priest (Sales): pinged Marco; he said he'll send assets by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Rae (Onboarding PM): will send invites once assets arrive. I can also add a 15-min pre-kickoff for infra if needed.

Dana (CS): I'll email Marco a summary of owners and next steps after this thread. Also adding a renewal reminder in Gainsight for month 9. :white_check_mark:
